query.description: I run a mobile radiology unit at a private multi-specialty clinic in Singapore with 25 staff. Our team spends too much time manually logging patient details and entering identifiers for each scan, which slows down patient visits. I need someone to shadow our daily workflow, map the current process, and identify where automation can save time. The goal is to reduce manual tasks so we can serve more patients without adding staff. Deliverable: report with process map, automation opportunities, and estimated time savings per scan. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.
